policy: All audit probability/pick fields deliberately blank. Passing arithmetic is not verified predictive accuracy, fixture identity, or a certified current market.

findings.title: Non-open market state
findings.detail: Two captured Bovada quotes have state S and are used in future-row consensus. Their state is not confirmed open; this audit does not infer the provider’s undocumented state semantics. Require explicitly open markets.

findings.title: Five-hour start disagreement
findings.detail: Four joins for two LoL fixtures have a 300-minute start discrepancy. One shared competition token allows a join up to 720 minutes, while the published method describes 90 minutes. Do not certify the join without an official schedule/identity reconciliation.

findings.title: In-play consensus
findings.detail: The captured ex-Keyd Stars–Galorys row includes an in-play Bovada quote. It is a past fixture and is flagged as past by the board, but the consensus calculation still uses the live value. Separate prematch and in-play inputs.

findings.title: No freshness/lock gate in expanded consensus
findings.detail: The expanded build joins and averages quotes without checking quote age, market open state, or fixture pick-lock time. A scheduled refresh is not a validity gate. Apply the root current-board safety rules before showing a current pick.

findings.title: Outcome ordering assumption
findings.detail: The expanded Bovada parser assigns outcome prices by array position rather than competitorId. Captured samples inspected here align; no actual reversed-price incident is asserted. Reordering outcomes would silently invert prices. Join prices by competitorId and require a bijection.

findings.title: Publication can continue after errors
findings.detail: expanded-lines.yml converts collector, origination, verifier, renderer and local-link errors to successful echo commands; its commit step runs always. A failed refresh can publish mixed/stale files without failing the workflow. Preserve evidence separately; make validation and atomic publication fail closed.

findings.title: API inventory is not lobby eligibility
findings.detail: The expanded inventory contains 821 forfeited records, mostly historical. Its future subset also includes a started fixture. Enumerating the full API is useful, but it is not evidence that every API row is currently offered in the pick’em lobby.

findings.title: Model probabilities are estimates
findings.detail: Official Valve ratings match, but the scale-400 conversion is not an official Valve win probability and no calibration is demonstrated here. The board labels originated estimates, but its footer also says nothing is estimated. Correct that conflicting statement.
